i1.title: Swiss Arabian Vanilla 01 Extrait de Parfum 50ml

  • Base: Bourbon Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood, Musk

  • Brand: Swiss Arabian
  • Concentration: Extrait de Parfum
  • Size: 50ml
  • Scent profile: Floral · Gourmand · Vanilla

  • A sparkling pink pepper and coconut opening

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
